description: This file defines the internal class ClientManifestProvider, which creates and provides a GrainManifest representing the locally available grain interface types in an Orleans distributed application. It includes methods to generate the manifest based on provided interface properties, options, and resolvers.

classes.name: ClientManifestProvider
classes.description: Creates and exposes a GrainManifest of the local grain interface types, based on configuration and interface providers.

methods.name: ClientManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client manifest by creating an interface manifest from provided properties, options, and resolver.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Generates an immutable dictionary representing the grain interface types and their properties, validating uniqueness and populating properties through providers.
